what_is_closed: Eq. (123), registered row scaling, and K2=sqrt(beta^2+zeta^2) reduce the generic determinant to r=abs(beta)/zeta; all delta factors cancel exactly.
The divided-difference transform on each of ten tensor components removes the generic eigenvalue-gap zero and gives a positive confluent-chart determinant on 20/21<=r<=21/20.
The corrected source-ODE-consistent Jordan chart has a separate positive determinant formula; its determinant is kept separate because chart basis normalization changes determinant magnitude.
Conservative analytic lower bounds are recorded for all three charts, and the formulas match direct determinants on the 92-point ratio/delta screen.
what_remains_open: A determinant lower bound alone does not bound sigma_min(S) or ||S^-1|| without controlling the remaining singular values/operator norm.
The three basis charts still need a common transition estimate in the target Kreiss norms.
Imaginary/high-frequency limits, the full complex closed half-plane, shift-family uniformity, and variable-coefficient CPBC evolution remain open.

equation_or_mapping.domain: beta<0, zeta>0, delta=max(abs(beta),zeta) in (0,1e-2], r=abs(beta)/zeta in (0,infinity)
equation_or_mapping.bound_derivation: For delta<=0.01 and b=abs(beta), a=-lambda1=(R-b*zeta)/(1-b^2) obeys sqrt(1-delta^2)-delta^2<=a<=sqrt(1+delta^2)/(1-delta^2). Therefore F=zeta+(1-b)*a>=(1-delta)*a_lower and K1<=sqrt((delta*(1+a_upper))^2+a_upper^2+1), so F^(8/5)/K1>0.6955. With q=min(r,1/r), g(q)=(1-q^2)/sqrt(1+q^2) has g'(q)=-q*(3+q^2)/(1+q^2)^(3/2)<=0; outside the confluent band q<=20/21 and g(q)>0.0673. In the confluent band R>=sqrt(1-delta^2), min(1,r)>=20/21, r<=21/20, so its bracket shape exceeds 1.2823. The corrected Jordan determinant is >=4/(1+0.01^2)^5.
equation_or_mapping.claim_boundary: analytic positive lower bounds for the rescaled determinant on beta<0, zeta>0, 0<delta<=1e-2, with separate generic, confluent, and corrected-Jordan basis charts; this does not bound the inverse operator or prove a Kreiss estimate
